CORE DETAILS
Jurisdiction
Seattle, WA
Permit
Commercial Building / Tenant Improvement Permit
Fees
Fee Estimate: $924+ building permit for an $8,000 valuation baseline in Seattle; for a $145,000 commercial TI, expect roughly $1,800 - $3,500 for the building permit plus about $371 for electrical if a panel/major electrical permit is needed, or less if the lighting controls are a smaller electrical scope. Final fee needs plan-review verification against the exact scope and valuation
Timeline
Varies by jurisdiction
Where to apply
Seattle Department of Construction & Inspections (SDCI)
SUMMARY
Required permit package: Commercial Building / Tenant Improvement Permit; Electrical Permit; Mechanical Permit — HVAC System Work (Commercial). Conditional guidance: Plumbing Permit; Planning / Zoning Use Clearance.
